name: Apple M1 Pro (14- or 16-core GPU)
memory_bandwidth_basis: 200 GB/s is the figure the llama.cpp #4167 scoreboard prints for both the 14-core and 16-core GPU M1 Pro, and it is Apple's published unified-memory bandwidth for M1 Pro. One die, two GPU bins.
notes: M1 Pro as binned in the #4167 scoreboard: 14-core and 16-core GPU, both at 200 GB/s, up to 32 GB unified memory (MacBook Pro 14/16-inch, 2021). Distinct from apple-m1-max (400 GB/s). memory_bus_bit is null; not back-computed from bandwidth.
